g.text: K7: FP8 e4m3 changes two layouts, nothing else
1. FP8 WGMMA reads only K-major operands
K stored (N, d), d contiguous: K-major already
PV: contraction over the sequence axis
BF16 could take V (N, d) as MN-major; FP8 cannot.
So V is stored transposed, (d, N), N contiguous.
2. P needs a different register packing
per 16 columns of a row, threads t0..t3 of the row group hold:
FP8 A operand (4 consecutive k per 32-bit register):
BF16: the two agree, the cast is a free reinterpretation.
FP8: exchange 16-bit halves between the 4 lanes (shfl.sync with
c = 0x1C1F, so lane indices are relative to each 4-lane segment),
then byte permute. Without it the kernel multiplies the wrong
rows of V: max error 11.9 vs 0.05 with it.
Per-tensor scales: s_q = max|Q| / 448, same for K and V. The kernel multiplies the scores by s_q s_k / sqrt(d) before the softmax and the output by s_v / l at the end.
P in [0, 1] is cast to e4m3 unscaled (3 mantissa bits: relative step 1/8). Accumulation stays FP32, output stays BF16.
